correctness.rationale: Support function of P_q equals three coordinate segments plus six short-root segments, giving centered zonotope volume 8+48q+84q²+32q³ by 3x3 minors. Separate fresh exact integer checker enumerated all 16,215 anchored vertex quadruples; every determinant coefficient obeyed |d_k|<=(16,48,64,32)_k and precisely one triple attained all bounds. Group action makes 12 optimizer quadruples, pairwise disjoint, covering all 48 vertices exactly once; exposed-face argument excludes nonvertex maxima. Sympy independently verified derivative numerator 10q^4-27q²-26q-6; Descartes plus signs yield unique q>0 minimizer. Singular q=0 excluded from orbit count.
